OccupationId: # WorldObserver — modern-day occupations (custom). One row per schedule slot
# same OccupationId are grouped. LocationKey is a concrete location id from the modern seed,
# or HomeLocation for the character's own home, or empty for no specific location.
# baker — processes ingredients into bread/pastries at the bakery (Work-type, has ovens/tools)
# farmer — grows crops/produce in the fields (Work-type, has farm tools)
# food_worker — processes produce into packaged meals at the food factory
# orchardist — tends the orchard, harvesting fruit
